id.description: Stable slug, e.g. 'hostname-title-year'. Never changes once created.

ppo_ppi.description: PPO/PPI details, 'None' if explicitly none, 'Not specified' if unknown

registration_open.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Null if unknown (then treated as already open until deadline).

deadline.description: Registration deadline, YYYY-MM-DD. Required when date_status is 'confirmed' (or absent); null when date_status is 'expected'.

apply_url.description: Direct link to application portal (Unstop, Devfolio, company site...)

source_url.description: Page where the info was verified

needs_review.description: true = hidden from public site until a human approves

review_notes.description: What the agent could not verify

region.description: Where the competition is based/open. Defaults to India if absent.

date_status.description: 'confirmed' = dates announced by organiser. 'expected' = recurring annual competition whose 2026-27 dates are not yet announced; shown as Upcoming (dates expected).

expected_window.description: Required when date_status is 'expected'. Short text such as 'Usually Nov-Dec (based on 2025 edition)'. Must cite evidence in review_notes.
